name: v1.3.0
body:
## Release notes

This release

- Improves the session command user experience by introducing a more interactive terminal emulator 
- Changes the default value of the `add` and `gen` commands `repeat` flag to `true`
- Upgrades all dependencies to their latest stable version

## Changelog

https://github.com/GGP1/kure/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0
